layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Stegosaurid thagomizer morphology
features: A long clay dinosaur tail ending in four large, sharp spikes (thagomizer)
The spikes are arranged in pairs and angled outwards, made of a light tan clay with subtle 'grain' textures
The tail itself is a deep forest green clay with heavy wrinkles and scale impressions
The base of each spike has a thicker 'socket' look where it meets the tail
In the background, the smaller dorsal plates are visible to provide context for the creature
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic side-view shot focusing on the tail spikes. The lighting creates sharp highlights on the tips of the spikes to emphasize their defensive nature. This serves as a 'Tail Spikes' morphology icon. No text.
